mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals monetary tightening, which increases equity discount rates and reduces forward S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate (indicating aggressive monetary easing amid economic distress) triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS down and UNRATE up) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%), a monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly housing starts (HOUST) reflects robust consumer demand and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 5-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a synchronized expansion in both demand and supply, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST up and INDPRO up) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260.0), a monthly increase in the consumer price index signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0 and CPIAUCSL increases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.
